name: MEALCRAFT
tagline: Photograph your fridge and get five recipes with nutrition, in a blocky game-style interface.

awards: Best Everyday Life & Wellbeing [Human-Centered Design] Project

problem: People give up on cooking with what they have and waste food.
solution: Gemini vision identifies ingredients and generates recipes with steps and nutrition, presented in a game-inspired UI.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a fridge photo and watch recipes get 'crafted'.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Everyday Life & Wellbeing [Human-Centered Design] Project” among 112 submissions.
The game styling makes planning feel playful.

lessons: A familiar visual style turns a chore into play.
